profile.name: Mahmoud Hany Mazroa
profile.summary: Passionate Game Developer dedicated to blending technical execution with narrative vision to craft immersive experiences. A collaborative problem-solver skilled in thoughtful level design and rapid prototyping, seeking to build high-quality game systems in a professional studio.

education.degree: Bachelor of Computer and Information Sciences (Digital Multimedia)
education.institution: Ain Shams University and University of East London

nodes.title: ESCCTRL
nodes.summary: A moody 2D atmospheric platformer built entirely in SFML and C++ during an intensive 3-day game jam. The gameplay revolves around shape-shifting mechanics and deep parallax layering that reacts dynamically to the player's movement.

nodes.title: Subject Null
nodes.summary: A narrative-driven VR puzzle game designed exclusively for the Meta Quest ecosystem. Players must master dynamic mesh slicing and toggle between distinct vision states to navigate a mysterious facility and solve spatial challenges.

nodes.title: VR Wave Shooter
nodes.summary: An intense, wave-based VR shooter optimized specifically for the performance constraints of standalone headsets. It challenges players to survive against scalable enemy spawning while carefully managing a strict and unforgiving ammo economy.

nodes.title: Cyber Salvage
nodes.summary: A dual-loop mobile title pairing arena survival with a financial-literacy economy sim, commissioned by the National Bank of Egypt. Players fight to earn resources, then return to a hub to invest, balance, and upgrade a factory using simulated market mechanics.
keyContributions: Designed and built the dual-loop structure connecting Arena survival to Hub-based economy management
Migrated architecture from Singletons to Dependency Injection, eliminating memory leaks and hidden dependencies
Built the Hub's factory upgrade progression system and simulated market economy loop
Integrated gamified fraud/cybersecurity awareness prompts into the Arena survival phase
Balanced economy pacing across both loops to keep progression rewarding
Configured cinematic camera transitions for milestone moments (e.g. Level 5 upgrade sequence)
Built UI scripting and Unlit UI setups for presentation elements
Integrated AI-generated SFX (ElevenLabs) for character audio

nodes.title: The Learning Lens
nodes.summary: An immersive VR/AR educational application built to transform traditional interactive learning environments. It utilizes robust real-time backend synchronization to support scalable lesson plans and seamless virtual hands-on experiences.
